seen_summary: Search: 34 of 34 scaled, 0 fixed. Main: 65 of 65 scaled, 0 fixed. Ollama: 45 scaled, 5 fixed (the switch labels at 16 px). Settings: 46 scaled, 6 fixed (switch labels at 16 px). Permissions: 2 scaled, 11 fixed (title, 5 switch labels at 16 px, 5 descriptions at 12 px). Developer: 52 scaled, 9 fixed (switch labels and 2 Steam buttons at 16 px). About: 9 scaled, 4 fixed (section titles and the language dropdown at 16 px). Every fixed word is 16 px (or 12 px for Permissions descriptions) at all three sizes. Section fold titles on Ollama, Settings and Developer DID scale (they are the plugin's own).
expected: Only Steam-drawn words stay fixed: section titles, switch labels and descriptions, Steam buttons, dropdowns.
verdict: PASS - every word that stayed fixed is a Steam control (switch label or description, Steam button, dropdown, Steam section title). No word the plugin draws itself stayed fixed.
caveats: The fixed/not fixed call per word is made from the class names and the runbook's list, not from the code; the 'drawn_by' column is the same for all rows. Switch descriptions on Ollama/Settings/Developer tabs were not separately listed in the fixed set, so they either scale or do not exist there. The emoticon art and LB/RB marks were not in the probe (no text node). Probe sizes are computed font-size, not pixels on screen.
side_effect: Text size changed Small -> Normal -> Large -> Small (the plugin re-saved settings each time). Put back to Small and confirmed in the file by key name (chat_text_size = small). One stray LEFT press moved the ring off the size buttons to the Steam side rail; one RIGHT brought it back; nothing was activated. Two B presses on the Search tab went back to Main and then to the tab bar; harmless.
